description: A sixteen-step sequencer with a two-operator FM voice of its own, each step holding a whole set of voice settings

params.text: Sets the level of the sound leaving the module
Sets how many steps play before the sequence starts over
Sets how often the selected step plays; at zero the step is silent
Sets the pitch of the selected step
Sets the carrier's ratio against the pitch for the selected step
Sets the modulator's ratio against the pitch for the selected step
Feeds the modulator back on itself for the selected step
Sets how hard the modulator drives the carrier for the selected step
One stage of the envelope that shapes the carrier on the selected step: its attack, decay, sustain or release
One stage of the envelope that shapes the modulator on the selected step: its attack, decay, sustain or release
Sets the level of the selected step
Picks that step for editing, and shows its settings on the knobs below
Sets that setting at random on every step at once
Puts that setting back to its starting value on every step at once
Sets how long the note of the selected step is held
Holds a randomise to musical ratios only, the halves and doubles of the pitch
Sets the direction the sequence travels through its steps
Sounds the selected step
Sets how far a randomise is allowed to move that setting
Makes the randomise button work on the selected step alone rather than on all sixteen
Keeps zero out of a randomise of the divisions, so no step is left silent
Holds a randomise of the envelopes to their decay times, leaving the other stages at zero
Randomises every setting at once, each within the amount set for it
Starts and stops the sequence

inputs.text: Each trigger here advances the sequence by one step
A trigger here sends the sequence back to its first step
Added to the length knob, 10V covering the sixteen steps
Sets one voice setting for all sixteen steps at once, a polyphonic channel to a step; which setting depends on the jack, and its label says so
Added to the play mode knob, a volt per mode
A gate here sounds the selected step
Randomise triggers, one channel to a setting: the first channel randomises everything, then the ratios, indexes, feedback, pitches, envelopes, divisions, levels and lengths
A voltage here seeds the random number generator, so the same voltage always gives the same result from a randomise

outputs.text: The voice, carrier and modulator as they are set
The pitch of the step now playing
A trigger at the end of each pass through the sequence
The voice with the two operators swapped, the modulator driven by the carrier
The carrier alone with its feedback

notes: the voice knobs work on one step at a time; press a step button to bring that step's settings onto them
menu: Copy step — copies the settings of the selected step
Paste step — writes the copied settings into the selected step
Copy current step to all steps — gives all sixteen steps the settings of the selected step
Snap ratios CV to musical ratios — holds the ratios set from the polyphonic CV inputs to musical ratios
Enable pitch quantization — snaps the pitch output to a root and a scale
Pitch quantize root note — sets the root the pitch output is snapped to
Pitch quantize scale — sets the scale the pitch output is snapped to

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.10: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
